text.en_us: TACZ only fires on a keyboard PRESS. TAP / LONG_PRESS / DOUBLE_TAP / RELEASE do not emit that PRESS, so inspect will not run. Set the controller trigger to PRESS (once) or HOLD. Keep the Minecraft binding as H (or any keyboard key), not Unbound.
text.zh_cn: TACZ 只在键盘按下瞬间（PRESS）触发。TAP / LONG_PRESS / DOUBLE_TAP / RELEASE 不会发出这次 PRESS，检视不会生效。请将手柄触发模式设为 PRESS（点一下）或 HOLD（按住），并把 Minecraft 键位保持为 H（或任意键盘键），不要清成未绑定。

text.en_us: TACZ crawl needs a keyboard PRESS (and RELEASE if hold-to-crawl is on). TAP / LONG_PRESS / DOUBLE_TAP / RELEASE do not emit that PRESS, so crawl will not toggle or hold. If TACZ hold-to-crawl is on, bind HOLD; if crawl is a toggle, bind PRESS. Keep the Minecraft binding as C (or any keyboard key), not Unbound.

text.en_us: Aim already works from KeyMapping.isDown() (default right mouse). Use HOLD on the controller binding.
